title: 第25章 谁允许你们离开了第26章 谁敢欺负你我灭他满门
lines: 魏佳怡沉吟道：“我回去先问问，我二姨夫就是开药材行的，或许真有渠道也说不定。”
“嗯，多谢了，这卡里面还有一千五百万，就当我我购买药材的定金。”
唐明将至尊金龙卡又还了回去。
魏佳怡笑着摇头：“我来之前，爷爷专门嘱咐说把这张卡送给您，要是再被我拿回去，还不得被我爷爷骂死啊。”
“唐先生，钱的事倒是不急，魏家会全力帮你收集药材，对了，您需要的药材有名称吗？”
魏佳怡眨眨美眸：“我们加个微信吧，你把需要的药材名称发给我。”
唐明拿出手机，同她加了微信。
随后写了十几种珍贵药材发了过去，有很多药材地球并没有，所以只能用替代药材。
他前世身为界域仙尊，除了战力无双外，这炼丹炼药的本事也不差，好几次死里逃生，都是靠着自己炼制的救命神丹。
驾驶位上的魏佳怡，嘴角也泛出笑容，能够和唐明交好，自然是她愿意看到的结果。
天色渐晚。
兰博基尼开进了青湖小区。
“前面左转，然后直行五十米，对对，就这里……”
唐明还没下车，就看到柳姨家门口围了不少人。
柳姨一家人都在，可对面的人数更多，而且一个个满脸狠色不像是善类。
为首之人，正是上次被他教训的史学坤，脑袋上还绑着绷带，此时满脸凶残的朝着陈志刚怒吼。
“停车！”
唐明语气冰冷下来。
魏佳怡听话的把车停下，唐明推开车门大步走上前，不管三七二十一，直接将后面的大汉给拨开。
好几人站立不稳，被其拨倒在地。
“小明。”
柳晴看到他面色微变，赶紧拉住他护在身后。
“说曹操曹操到，小子，你终于来了。”
史学坤狞笑出声：“那天敢偷袭老子，真是吃了熊心豹子胆了！我史学坤在中海混了这么久，还从没吃过这种亏！”
唐明正要说话。
柳晴抢先一步，娇喝道：“史学坤，我已经报警了，你们这已经是聚众闹事！”
“我闹哪门子的事？”
“你也别吓唬老子，市局我有的是关系，你看今天有没有人敢过来！”
史学坤目光阴寒下来：“柳晴，你欠的那两千万还剩下四天时间，时间一到，法院就会强制抵押你家房子。”
“法院的事我不管，我今天来主要就是为了这小子来的！”
“我劝你们把他交出来，否则，待会闹出什么事就说不清了。”
他面色狠厉到了极点，从旁边人手中拿过一根钢制棒球棍。
柳姨一家人面色剧变。
尤其是陈志刚，作为家里唯一的成年男性，见到这种局面也有些害怕，对方人多势众，万一打起来，他们一家人肯定得吃亏。
“妈，唐明惹出来的事，凭什么要我们家来承担后果。”
“随他去吧……”
陈思琪更是吓得有些失态，躲在陈志刚身后弱弱道。
“陈思琪！这是你该说出来的话吗！”
“我今天就把话放这里，有我在，谁都不敢欺负小明，史学坤，老娘今天大不了就和你拼了！”
“一群王八蛋，欺人太甚！”
柳晴从厨房拿出两把菜刀，如同护崽的母老虎，疯狂，暴戾，还有些歇斯底里。
看到她这个模样，史学坤等人也有些惧色。
俗话说狠的怕不要命的，柳晴此时的状态明显是彻底疯狂搏命的状态。
“疯女人，你他妈以为自己是谁啊，拿着菜刀吓唬谁呢。”
content_en:
Wei Jiayi said thoughtfully: "I'll ask first when I go back. My second uncle is in the medical field. Maybe there is a channel."
"Well, thank you. There is still fifteen million in this card, which can be used as a deposit for me to buy medicinal materials."
Tang Ming returned the Supreme Golden Dragon Card.
Wei Jiayi smiled and shook her head: "Before I came, grandpa specifically told me to give you this card. If you take it back again, my grandpa will scold you to death."
"Mr. Tang, the money matter is not urgent. The Wei family will do their best to help you collect medicinal materials. By the way, do you need a name for the medicinal materials you need?"
Wei Jiayi blinked her beautiful eyes: "Let's add a WeChat account and you can send me the names of the medicinal materials you need."
"Okay."
Tang Ming took out his mobile phone and added WeChat with her.
Then I wrote about more than a dozen precious medicinal materials and sent them to them. Many medicinal materials are not available on earth, so I can only use substitute medicinal materials.
In his previous life, he was a Realm Immortal. In addition to his unparalleled combat power, he was also good at refining elixirs. He escaped from death several times by relying on the life-saving elixir he refined.
Wei Jiayi, who was sitting in the driver's seat, had a smile on her face. Being able to make friends with Tang Ming was naturally the result she wanted to see.
It's getting late.
Lamborghini drove into Qinghu Community.
"Turn left ahead, then go straight for fifty meters, yes, right here..."
Before Tang Ming got out of the car, he saw a lot of people gathered in front of Aunt Liu's house.
Aunt Liu and her family were all there, but there were more people on the opposite side, and all of them had ruthless faces that didn't look like good people.
The leader was none other than Shi Xuekun, who was taught a lesson by him last time. He still had a bandage on his head and was roaring at Chen Zhigang with a ferocious look on his face.
"Stop!"
Tang Ming's tone turned cold.
Wei Jiayi stopped the car obediently, and Tang Ming pushed open the car door and strode forward. Regardless of the situation, he directly pushed the big man behind him aside.
Several people were unable to stand firmly and were pushed to the ground.
"Xiao Ming."
Liu Qing saw his expression change slightly and quickly grabbed him to protect her.
"Said Cao Cao, Cao Cao is here, boy, you are finally here."
Shi Xuekun laughed ferociously: "You dared to sneak attack on me that day, you are really brave! I, Shi Xuekun, have been in Zhonghai for so long, and I have never suffered such a loss!"
Tang Ming was about to speak.
Liu Qing took the lead and shouted: "Shi Xuekun, I have already called the police, you are already gathering a crowd to make trouble!"
"What am I causing trouble?"
"Don't scare me, I have many connections in the city bureau. See if anyone dares to come here today!"
Shi Xuekun's eyes turned cold: "Liu Qing, there are still four days left for the 20 million you owe. When the time is up, the court will force your house to be mortgaged."
"I don't care about the court. I'm here mainly for this kid!"
"I advise you to hand him over, otherwise it will be unclear what trouble will occur later."
His expression was extremely stern, and he took a steel baseball bat from the person next to him.
The expressions of Aunt Liu's family changed dramatically.
Especially Chen Zhigang, as the only adult male in the family, was a little scared when he saw this situation. The other party had a large number of people. If there was a fight, their family would definitely suffer.
"Mom, why should our family bear the consequences of what Tang Ming caused?"
"Let him be..."
Chen Siqi was so frightened that she lost her composure and hid behind Chen Zhigang and said softly.
"Chen Siqi! Is this what you should say?"
"I will put my words here today. As long as I am here, no one dares to bully Xiao Ming. Shi Xuekun, I will fight you today at the worst!"
"A bunch of bastards, they bully others too much!"
Liu Qing took out two kitchen knives from the kitchen, like a tigress guarding her cubs, crazy, violent, and a little hysterical.
Seeing her like this, Shi Xuekun and others were also a little scared.
As the saying goes, those who are too cruel are afraid of losing their lives. Liu Qing's state at this time was obviously a state of complete madness and fighting for her life.
"Crazy woman, who the hell do you think you are? Who are you trying to scare with a kitchen knife?"
title_en: Chapter 25: Who allowed you to leave? Chapter 26: Whoever dares to bully you, I will destroy him.
